messages.content: Why can't Muslims live on Jupiter?

Muslims can’t live on Jupiter for the same reason nobody can: Jupiter is a gas giant with no solid surface, crushing atmospheric pressure, extreme storms, deadly radiation, and temperatures/conditions incompatible with human life.

Religiously, there’s no rule forbidding Muslims from living there—if humans could safely live on another planet, Islamic practices could be adapted, such as determining prayer direction and times.
